title: Concept: Dynamic load via syscall.Exec (go) — review required
description: In go, syscall.Exec loads a plugin, replaces the process image or marks a string as trusted HTML, so the value decides what code runs or what the browser renders. The remedy is a fixed, reviewed call (exec with an args list).
applicability: go dynamic loading; single-line lexical scope.
risk: Code execution or XSS; HIGH severity.
